restored_once: original six-party records, original party count, full mail, and loaned Safari Balls
context_lifetime: through Exit; Abort remains allowed only before transfer
post_settlement_policy: PC, party, mail, and bag edits made after preparation survive context cleanup
serialization_policy: blocked while the contest context exists, through successful claim or explicit forfeit and until Exit
campaign_binding: Generated campaign scripts bind judging and timeout to strict preparation, retry PC transfer and bag-full reward claims, require explicit reward forfeit, and gate Exit
reward_policy: Claim retries after bag-full failure; only explicit ForfeitReward waives an unclaimed reward; forfeited claims do not mutate the bag
transfer_policy: requires ending, judged and prepared settlement; successful PC transfer is idempotent and preserves the selected Pokemon record
